feeds.title: The Fashion Doll Chronicles
feeds.description: All things related to fashion dolls and their world.

feeds.title: Black Doll Collecting
feeds.description: I am a Black-doll enthusiast, doll historian, and author of three books on the subject of black dolls. I have been collecting Black dolls since 1991. Black dolls are my passion, my drug of choice. They renew my spirit and the void has not been filled yet!

feeds.title: The Toy Box Philosopher
feeds.description: My name is Emily and I live in rural Maine with my husband, two teenaged boys, three dogs, four parakeets and a bunch of cute fish. This blog features in-depth reviews and thoughts about a wide variety of dolls and doll-related toys.

feeds.title: American Girl Doll News
feeds.description: Hi. My name is Sydney. I have 35 dolls and I love making stopmotions with them and leak finding!

feeds.title: Desperately Seeking Dolls
feeds.description: I've been collecting dolls my entire adult life. I have antique bisque dolls from the 1800's, Vogue Ginny Dolls from the early 1960's, Barbies, Silkstones, FR, Misaki, Dynamite Girls, Momoko, Tonner, Gene. A litte bit of everything. I guess my favorite bumper sticker sums up my life. 'I set off to conquer the world but got distracted by something sparkly.'

feeds.title: Miss Missy Paper Dolls
feeds.description: Hello, call me Miss Missy. I collect and draw paper dolls. I also collect dolls like Barbie and lalaloopsy. I enjoy reading and watching horror movies. I also like anime, manga, comics, cartoons,toys, and many other things.

feeds.title: Dolls, Dolls, Dolls
feeds.description: I have been collecting dolls now since the 1990's although I already had a few before that. I collect several types including dolls from the 1960s, the type I played with as a child. In fact I still have my first baby doll and several of my other old dolls including a Sindy from 1963 or 64.

feeds.title: Monster Crafts
feeds.description: I'm a young woman from Spain. I mainly collect playline dolls, specially Monster High, Ever After High and some Barbies. I balance my hobby with my full time job and my studies.

feeds.title: I Dream of Jeanne Marie
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to I Dream of Jeanne Marie, a website and blog where you'll find the talk revolves around the things I love dolls, sewing, and whatever connects them together. Occasionally I may throw in a great recipe or a home improvement project I've finished. I love reading, cooking and baking, a variety of crafts, antique shopping, working on our 1892 fixer upper house, and loving my family. I hope you'll join me as we travel down this road together.

feeds.title: Jenn's Mini Worlds
feeds.description: I am an avid miniaturist. This blog will be devoted to minis! And where I am on my numerous projects. I hope to post tips that will help miniaturists and also learn from other mini lovers. I create minis for pleasure only, not for sale (thus far). I am always learning, so my projects are not picture perfect. But the idea is to have fun and try to create something beautiful along the way.

feeds.title: Antique Lilac Blog
feeds.description: Martha Boers is an award-winning Canadian doll maker and costumer specializing in fantasy and historical-style costumes. This is aplace to share my doll costume creations and doll photography.

feeds.title: Wren*Feathers
feeds.description: A Blog of Sewing and crafting for dolls...

feeds.title: Oh Sew Kat!
feeds.description: Fashion Trends for Dolls & their Friends; PDF Sewing Patterns for 14-18 inch Doll Clothes.

feeds.title: Collecting Fashion Dolls by Terri Gold
feeds.description: Terri Gold, Award winning, retired New York City public school art teacher, teacher trainer and photographer now spends wonderful days playing with dolls. Here you will get News, reviews and photographs of Modern Fashion Dolls including Sybarite, Kingdom Doll, Fashion Royalty, Tonner Doll, Gene Marshall, Barbie and my own experiences as a doll collector.

feeds.title: Austin Doll Collectors Society
feeds.description: The Austin Doll Collectors Society is an organization of antique, vintage, and modern doll collectors, dealers, and artisans. We meet on the first Monday of each month and our meetings are fun and educational. We begin with refreshments and socializing, and, following our brief business meeting, there is a special doll-related program and 'show and tell.'

feeds.title: Planet of the Dolls
feeds.description: I'm a mom of three, collector of too much stuff, and I talk too much. A doll collector talking about her doll collection, life, childhood, thrift store shopping, family,travel, art, and whatever strikes her.

feeds.title: Transformative Healing Dolls Blog
feeds.description: I've been making dolls for about five years now. I believe that dolls serve as representations and reminders of the best part of ourselves. I am exited to share with you here my learnings about new methods and techniques for doll making and healing.

feeds.title: Izannah Walker Journal
feeds.description: My name is Paula Walton, as I mentioned in 'About this journal'. I'm a working craftsperson. I've been self-employed since 1986, when I started selling the items that I make under the name A Sweet Remembrance. Among other things, I am a doll maker, a dressmaker that specializes in reproduction women's and children's clothing, and a freelance designer.

feeds.title: Dolldom
feeds.description: DOLLDOM is a showcase for ideas intended to inspire, amuse, and guide the modern dollector. Fashion, art, décor and gastronomy, it's all here for you and your friends. It's Life Deluxe, DOLLDOM style.

feeds.title: Ayal Armon Doll Couture Blog
feeds.description: As a longtime fashion doll collector, Ayal Armon has created miniature clothing and accessories for the most glamorous of fashion dolls. He has sewn for a complete gamut of fashion doll body types, sizes and materials, bringing him a well-rounded library of experience in miniature fit.

feeds.title: Indy Cloth Dollmakers
feeds.description: Indy Cloth Dollmakers - An Indianapolis, Indiana doll club, celebrating the cloth doll as art.

feeds.title: My Little Doll Corner
feeds.description: I've been happily married for over twenty years. I have two grown-up daughters, and we also have two black cats who wandered into our family. I like to knit and I sew, mainly clothes for my family. I also sew clothes for my dolls, some modern and some vintage style. I'm an amateur fashion historian, and it's easier to sew a Victorian dress for a doll than it is for me!

feeds.title: The Adventures of Steampunk Addie
feeds.description: Steampunk Addie's story is a sci-fi/fantasy version of Addy's. Steam power is still widely used and incorporates prominent elements of either science fiction or fantasy. She's also a time-traveler....

feeds.title: The Bold Doll
feeds.description: This website is an electronic collection of dolls that interest me, as well as a miscellany of my magazine features.

feeds.title: Izannah Walker Chronicles
feeds.description: Izannah Frankford Walker lived in the nineteenth century, operating a cottage industry making pressed cloth dolls in a time when most women couldn't own property or vote. She first patented her dollmaking process in 1873, but she may have been making dolls as early as 1840. Her dolls have the look of primitive folk portraits from the mid 1800s.

feeds.title: Margaret Ann
feeds.description: Hi! I am a 27-year-old Polish girl living in Geneva, Switzerland. Apart from being a doll collector, I am a wife, an influencer and an entrepreneur. As you can see, I am a kid at heart 🙂 I am also into having a healthy lifestyle and I love cooking.

feeds.title: DeeBeeGee's Virtual Black Doll Museum™
feeds.description: DeeBeeGee's Virtual Black Doll Museum is the first and only virtual Black doll museum where antique, vintage, modern, and OOAK Black dolls are celebrated 24/7. The museum endeavors to preserve Black-doll history by documenting past, current, and newly-released, historically-significant Black dolls.

feeds.title: Paper Doll School
feeds.description: Busy raising two boys as a stay-at-home mom. I spend as much time as I can creating art of all kinds, including fine art, digital art, and my life-long hobby: paper dolls. Tutorials include: pencil, watercolor, photoshop, illustrator, and more.Tutorial blog focused on how to make paper dolls. Tips, techniques and templates for making paper dolls.

feeds.title: Doll Mum's blog
feeds.description: I'm interested in dolls and dollshouses, and have been ever since I was a very small child. Somehow that interest has never waned, despite some teasing during teenage years, and plenty of changes in my life since then. Now I enjoy sharing my interests in dolls, dollshouses, sewing, knitting, music and reading with my two daughters and my tolerant husband.

feeds.title: DOLLS Magazine
feeds.description: DOLLS magazine is the collectible doll industry's No. 1 doll resource, covering trends and news and the latest dolls on the market. Impartial and expert advice on collectible dolls, including fashion dolls, BJD dolls, limited-edition dolls and art dolls, from DOLLS Magazine.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Doll Collectors Daughter
feeds.description: Confessions of a Doll Collectors Daughter is written by Ashley. Hope that the blog can show non-collectors that you don't need to outgrow the things you love just because you get older.

feeds.title: Inside the Fashion Doll Studio
feeds.description: I am an avid Silkstone and Fashion Royalty collector who enjoys photographing her collection. I enjoy sharing tips I have learned about doll photography and collecting as well as making and displaying dioramas.

feeds.title: American Girl Fan
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Jessica (also known as Liz)! I'm 23 years old and the author of this website that I started back when I was 14. Between my sister and I, we have a total of 20 dolls. I've been collecting since 2003 when I was 9 and got my first doll Molly for Christmas. I believe you can never be too old for dolls! 🙂

feeds.title: Lottie Dolls Blog
feeds.description: Lottie dolls' blog gives you all the real updates about the most recent fun activities & news of Lottie dolls that have happened in different places in the world. Subscribe to keep up with the latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: Ashton-Drake Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Ashton-Drake Galleries Blog! Join me in celebrating the joys of doll collecting, from sweet baby dolls to portrait dolls and more, each lovingly created by acclaimed Master Doll Artists. I'll also be sharing useful tips for caring for your Ashton-Drake dolls and more.

feeds.title: Fashion Doll Stylist
feeds.description: All things FASHION, all things DOLLS! From following trends to creating modern clothes, it's Fashion Design 101 for the doll collector. A DIY guide for creating sophisticated clothes and accessories for the 12' fashion doll.

feeds.title: Gingermelon Dolls
feeds.description: I'm a work-at-home mom of two handsome young men and wife to a dear, patient, loving man who puts up with all my fabrics, dolls, bears and other oddities which are slowly taking up every inch of our very tiny apartment!

feeds.title: MamAmor Dolls Blog
feeds.description: MamAmor Dolls are handcrafted educational birthing, breastfeeding and babywearing dolls created to help birthing families prepare their children for the arrival of new siblings. They are also wonderful educational tools for birth, breastfeeding and babywearing educators and professionals.

feeds.title: Willowynn Blog
feeds.description: My name is Margeaux Davis. I make cloth dolls and soft sculpture creatures using discarded fabric scraps, old woollen blankets, remnants and worn out clothing.

feeds.title: 1:12 scale modern model houses
feeds.description: I am a Swiss miniature model builder, in dollhouse scale 1:12. I design houses and interiors just for the fun of it! And I share 3D-printed modern scale furniture on Shapeways.com.

feeds.title: Kilmouski & Me
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! I am an artist and a metalsmith. I have always loved miniatures and dollhouses. My interest in making miniatures is not restricted to the metal work I do. This year I plan to design and build a dollhouse. I do not sell the miniatures I am making right now while I am trying to build my own collection.

feeds.title: Dutch Fashion Doll World
feeds.description: A Dutch Barbie collector in Holland. My name is Rogier and I'm from Holland. I started collecting dolls last august so I'm quite new in the fashion doll world.

feeds.title: David Wolfe's Paperdollywood Blog
feeds.description: Paper Doll, Fashion, Hollywood and other Glamorous News from Fashion Trend Forecaster and Artist David Wolfe

feeds.title: The Barbie Blog
feeds.description: A place to showcase Barbie collection and learn more about them. I love to snatch up dolls at yard sales and thrift stores, give them a spa day and make them fabulous! If you are on the hunt for a particular type of doll, you can probably find it on here.

feeds.title: Janie Carroll Designs Blog
feeds.description: Hello, from Jane Wilkes! I'm the owner and designer at Janie Carroll Designs. I provide high quality clothing and accessories for 18' dolls, such as the American Girl brand doll. You will love my quality fabrics, as well as my attention to fit and detail. I also offer custom crochet for children's hats and embroidery services for many projects - from handkerchiefs to tote purses to blankets.

feeds.title: Delightful World of Dolls Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Madison, or Madi for short; a fourteen-year-old girl who loves Jesus and American Girl dolls. I love to post about my hobby of professional doll collecting—unless, of course, my dolls are sneaky enough to do it themselves.

feeds.title: Pixie Dust Dolls
feeds.description: Hello, fellow collectors and crafters! I'm Amanda - the maker, toy reviewer, and content creator for Pixie Dust Dolls. This blog is about Doll Collecting, Toy Reviews, and Miniature Craft Projects.

feeds.title: Dolls And Daydreams Patterns Group Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah, the Indie Pattern Designer behind Dolls And Daydreams. I specialize in Fun & Easy Step by Step Photo Sewing and Machine Embroidery Tutorial Patterns so that even a beginner sewer will be able to make Dolls, Softies just like mine!

feeds.title: Karen mom of three's craft blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our blog! We here at Karen Mom of Three's Craft blog are passionate about doll play. We love our dolls big and small and creating for them. Our passion is sharing what we know with those who love dolls or who have a doll lover in their lives.

feeds.title: CraBBy GaBBy Dolls
feeds.description: An insight into my life, not only as a doll maker, but as Mother, wife and a person trying to figure out and fullfill my destiny in life Through Christ.

feeds.title: Appletotes & Co.
feeds.description: Our mission is to provide the highest quality and most stylish sewing patterns for dolls.

feeds.title: PennilessCaucasianRubbish American Doll Adventures
feeds.description: The blog focuses on all manner of 18inch dolls. From upcycling doll clothes, doing doll crafts, taking doll adventures, reviewing dolls, customizing dolls.

feeds.title: The Paper Nest
feeds.description: The Paper Nest Dolls is a collection of original artwork, all done by hand, and then turned into a digital stamp.

feeds.title: Never Grow Up
feeds.description: I started this blog as a celebration of some of the things I enjoy most. Some may find it odd that at thirty-four years of age, I have a blog about dolls and Disney characters. I've gotten some strange looks even when talking about it to some of my family and friends. That's okay, maybe I am a little bit odd. The original 'Beast's Belle' was too, you know. 🙂

feeds.title: The Multicrafteral Lab
feeds.description: My name is Arina (sounds like 'arena' for English speakers), I'm 26 and I live in Eastern Europe. I like to create pretty little things. I'm here to share my experiments in doll customizing, jewellery making and other crafty adventures.

feeds.title: Little Raven Creations - Doll Blog | Doll Fashions | Handmade Collectibles
feeds.description: At Little Raven Creations, we aim to provide beautiful, unique, and creative fashions for 18' playdolls, and also promote a variety of our handmade plushies for collectors.

feeds.title: Dirks' Dolls
feeds.description: The Dirks behind the page is me Wendy Dirks. I am semi-retired but have spent my professional life as a biological anthropologist and palaeontologist. I'm a scientist living in a small world. Not only will I share personal information about my life as a doll, but also palaeontology stories that I find interesting.

feeds.title: Verify Hope
feeds.description: I make Old time dolls, handmade heirlooms. I use the very best materials available for the task. Custom printed fabrics in scale with the little poseable bodies together with a distinctive and timeless face are all unique to Verity Hope.

feeds.title: The Paper Nest Dolls Challenge Blog
feeds.description: The Paper Nest Dolls is a line of digital and rubber stamps designed by Christine Young with the help of her devoted husband Larry Young.

feeds.title: Nuts About Dolls
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Nuts About Dolls.

feeds.title: Doll Loft
feeds.description: A blog about my dollmaking OOAK Izannah Walker dolls, and other dolls. I hand-sculpt all my doll heads from scratch, using no molds. I also make cloth dolls, using sometimes other people's patterns, and sometimes making my own. I also really find solace in our garden so there will be garden pictures.

feeds.title: Skull Academy Show
feeds.description: A blog about the Skull Academy Monster High doll show on our YouTube channel. Student pictures, school tours, student fashion and so much more. Monster High school house tours. Ever After High dolls. Bratz dolls.

feeds.title: For The Love Of Dolls
feeds.description: This blog records information I've gathered and my ideas and experiences with the dolls and action figures in my life.

feeds.title: A Day In The Life Of My Dolls
feeds.description: I have always loved Barbie dolls. I got my first doll at the age of 8 or 9 and she was a platinum bubble cut Barbie. As an adult, I have discovered the world of doll collecting and playing with them as an adult through several doll blogs. My interests now have expanded beyond Barbie to Fashion Royalty, Mixis, Pretty Girls and other 1:6 scale dolls and action figures.

feeds.title: Her Obsession errr My Obsession
feeds.description: Our family addiction to dolls started out with my Paternal Grandmother. I have always loved to collect Barbies, Bears and toys in General.

feeds.title: Cozy Comforts and Dolls
feeds.description: Sharing bits of daily life, nature, doll reviews and crochet.

feeds.title: Of Dolls
feeds.description: I've always had dolls, played with dolls, and collected dolls. Recently I decided to connect with other doll enthusiasts through a local doll club and blogging/talking about the dolls I own and love. Spring 2012 I moved to Japan and began posting Japan related posts on the blog. Outside of dolls, I enjoy reading, crafting, touring, my cat, and my husband. Not necessarily in that order.

feeds.title: Adorable Doll Clothes and Doll Accessories
feeds.description: A blog about doll clothes and doll accessories.

feeds.title: Dolls N' All
feeds.description: The Blog about all the things related to dolls.

feeds.title: Poppets & Posies
feeds.description: A Doll Blog authored by Laura Isabella Noelle.

feeds.title: Small Dolls in a Big World
feeds.description: I'm Dara, but most people call me AG Doll Artist! Drawing and dolls are two of my favorite things, along with photography, sewing, and many other creative things!

feeds.title: Rosies Dolls Clothes
feeds.description: It all started after Christmas 2001 when Alyssa was three! Santa left a Baby Born® doll at the end of her bed. When I went to buy some new doll clothes I found it really difficult to find any and those I did find were very expensive. Out came my sewing machine and I found myself having a lot of fun creating a whole new wardrobe for Alyssa's doll.

feeds.title: Plastically Perfect
feeds.description: Whether you're looking for photoshop makeup tips, DIY projects, diorama builds, or just a healthy dose of fashion for the ultimate fashionista herself (Barbie), you've come to the right place. This blog is written by, and for, adult doll hobbyists and collectors.

feeds.title: Living A Doll's Life
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Rhonda and I am an adult doll collector. I love crafts, painting, sewing and meeting doll collectors! My favorite dolls are American Girl, A Girl for All Time, Vintage Barbie, Vintage Madame Alexander, OOAK art dolls and mini dolls. In this blog ou will find American Girl Doll crafts, tutorials, news, doll reviews and DIY projects.

feeds.title: Arts and Crafts for your American Girl Doll
feeds.description: This blog contains free tutorials for crafts and sewing projects for American Girl dolls.

feeds.title: RAD Doll Clothes Blog
feeds.description: Requiem Art Designs is run by Gwendolyn, who recently took the jump into mad dolly science as a full time occupation after over ten years in the hobby. While these days she tries to compensate for the lack of clothing patterns for all of the many different sizes and shapes of 'fashion' dolls with a new pattern.

feeds.title: American Girl Ideas
feeds.description: American Girl Ideas is a doll blog that discusses topics like American Girl Doll, Dollhouse, Bedroom, DIY Crafts, Doll, Opening, Set Up, Videos & Reviews.

feeds.title: My Doll Best Friend Blog
feeds.description: My Doll Best Friend, the UK's destination online shop for standing and jointed play dolls from around the world for children and collectors. Follow this blog for the latest news and releases about dolls and doll related stuff.

feeds.title: I-Luv-Dolls
feeds.description: I am a collector of Black Barbie dolls, Barbie dolls, fashion dolls and action figures. I had a large doll collection as a child that even included a black Francie and a Julia doll. Once I became older, I still loved dolls but didn't play with them as much.

feeds.title: Doll-Clothes.com
feeds.description: The My Doll's Life blog focuses on the 18 inch doll marketplace, offering every 18″ doll lover and collector the latest in fashion, industry news, American Girl® style tips, activities, and much more!
